name: io.github.naimterrache-a11y/frigolog-haccp
title: Frigolog HACCP — French Food Safety Compliance
description: 19 tools covering French HACCP compliance for restaurants and food businesses: legal storage, cooking and cooling temperatures, shelf-life (DLC) rules, the 14 declarable allergens, the documents a DDPP inspector asks for, sanctions, cleaning plans, plus live RappelConso product recalls and Alim'confiance inspection scores. Every answer carries its sources (Légifrance, EUR-Lex, DGAL, DGCCRF) and a verification date.
